findings.trigger: A legacy `filing.created` snapshot payload without a numeric `revision` key reaches `filing.stage_changed`/`filing.closed`/`filing.reopened` before any later full `filing.work_changed` snapshot.
findings.expected: The brief should either surface the true unseen revision or explicitly report revision unavailability, consistently with the fail-closed provenance policy.
findings.actual: The replay's own revision bump is skipped when `it.m["revision"]` is missing or is not float64, so the brief item renders `Revision: 0` for that interval.
findings.impact: Cosmetic/informational only in the reviewed paths; verification/dependency/execution states are unaffected; fail-closed owner guard is independent of revision. No fabricate-and-pass risk.
findings.minimum_fix: In a future backend revision, either leave the revision undefined for the brief reader instead of defaulting to 0, or fold revision availability into the same fail-closed decision as owner provenance. Not required for the current P0 gate.
findings.regression_test_suggestion: Add a `TestReplayBrief` case with a revision-less legacy `filing.created` plus `filing.stage_changed`, asserting the chosen availability representation.

findings.trigger: Route param `matterId` is interpolated into local hrefs without `encodeURIComponent`, while `matter-scope.tsx:19,28` and `history/page.tsx:28,43` encode consistently.
findings.expected: Uniform, always-encoded id interpolation across matter routes.
findings.actual: Overview page lines 29/76 rely on the raw param; current id semantics (single dynamic segment, UUID-style record ids) make an actual break hard to reach.
findings.impact: No demonstrated defect in allowed id space; robustness/consistency only.
findings.minimum_fix: Wrap `matterId` with `encodeURIComponent` on those hrefs in a later frontend revision. Not required for the current P0 gate.
findings.regression_test_suggestion: Extend a matter page/route test with a percent-encoded id segment asserting stable same-matter links.
